E_engine_integration.note: No lmpu.model_* treatment arm is present; Batch 1 adds lmpu.model_async/lmpu.model_sync before the end-to-end claim can be evaluated.

end_to_end.note: Host model in the loop; every arm is scored on its decoded final answer. Token reductions require equal task correctness.

limitations: Trace-token is a labelled simulation; it cannot support any claim.
C2 measures the S1 park window; the treatment performs no model decode by construction.
C3 inlines derived-buffer metadata only, not any slice payload.
C4 uses 64 pure-function additions; it is control-plane evidence, not model-quality evidence.
C5 native runs in-process and excludes worker, IPC, and control-plane overhead.
Per-correct-task cost divides total spend by correct tasks; failures are paid for, not skipped.
Incorrect or failed baselines are retained; token reductions require equal task correctness.
Failures and incorrect answers are retained in the table.

C2_sleep_proof.note: The lmpu.sleep treatment parks the host in S1 for the measured job window and performs zero forward passes while parked.

C3_context_protection.note: A 16 MiB shared-memory buffer is represented in context by bounded-slice metadata; no slice payload is inlined.

C4_batching.note: One batch submission replaces one submission per item.

C5_wall_time.note: native runs the same computation in-process; LMPU includes worker, IPC, and control-plane overhead.

mechanism.note: Mechanism-only evidence (S1 park, bounded slices, batching, overhead). Not an end-to-end efficiency claim.

simulation_quarantine.note: trace_token is a labelled simulation; it cannot appear in any claim table. Its records remain in the raw table, flagged.
